description: Assigning the items of an iterable to several names: `a, b = pair`.
`first, *middle, last = items` collects the remaining items into a list, possibly empty.
`f(*args)` passes items positionally; `[*a, *b]` and `{*a, *b}` build new list and set.
`f(**options)` passes keyword arguments; `{**a, **b}` builds a new dict where later keys win.
`a, b = b, a` evaluates the right side first, so no temporary variable is needed.
